pulls.title: BGP-LS for BGP-only networks - V06 draft changes.
pulls.author: AravindBabuM
pulls.body:
Key changes from v05 to v06:

1. Section 4 tables simplified: Node, Link, and Prefix Attribute tables trimmed to SHOULD/RECOMMENDED TLVs only (Node Name, TE Router-IDs, Link Name, Max Bandwidth, Prefix Metric); other TLVs MAY be included per use case
2. Sections 4.4/4.5 combined: SR Policy and SRv6 SID Advertisements merged into a single compact section referencing RFC9857 and RFC9514
3. New use-case sections: Added IPFRR in BGP-only networks (Section 6.3) and Efficient Remote Protection for AI/ML fabrics (Section 6.4)
4. Section 6 restructured: Flattened hierarchy — SR-TE, IPFRR, and ERP as peer sections
5. Grammar/editorial fixes: "setup" → "set up", non-BCP14 "MAY" → "may", "sessions" → "IP addresses", Link Descriptor wording
6. New references: RFC5714, RFC9855, I-D.abdelsalam-rtgwg-ipfrr-bgp-only-network, I-D.clad-rtgwg-ipfrr-aiml, I-D.clad-rtgwg-efficient-remote-protection
